title: 市场剧烈波动：戈勒布却说，居然找不到具体原因
speaker: Jonathan Gaul

segments.en: With this now, Jonathan Gaul, a managed director, chief equity strategist at Seaport Research Partners. Jonathan, great to have you with us.
segments.zh: 现在有请Seaport的董事总经理兼首席权益策略师Jonathan Golub。Jonathan，很高兴你能来。

segments.en: Good to be as always. Well, let's start with the good news.
segments.zh: 很高兴一如既往。我们先从好消息开始吧。

segments.en: Let's start with the IPO and the pop that followed.
segments.zh: 我们先从IPO以及随后的上涨说起。

segments.en: Situate that in recent market history. This was something I think so many people were watching to see how it would play out.
segments.zh: 把它放在近期市场历史中看。很多人都在关注这件事会如何发展。

segments.en: Of course, we had the SpaceX IPO. A lot of enthusiasm surrounding this one.
segments.zh: 当然，我们经历了SpaceX的IPO。围绕它的热情很高。

segments.en: Walk us through the highs and the low. How do we go from such excitement to what we saw the day that followed?
segments.zh: 给我们讲讲高点与低点。我们如何从如此兴奋变成第二天看到的样子？

segments.en: Yeah, first of all, I'm not sure that there's... I don't think there's any specific event that happened this week that anyone can point to and say, this is why you had this roller coaster in the markets.
segments.zh: 首先，我不确定是否有……我认为本周没有发生任何具体事件能让人指出这就是市场过山车的原因。

segments.en: If you had a busted IPO and the market said, we're not supplying capital to these kind of companies, you would have a wipe out on that.
segments.zh: 如果IPO失败，市场说我们不会向这类公司提供资本，那就会一败涂地。

segments.en: That didn't happen. The market didn't have a problem.
segments.zh: 那没有发生。市场没有问题。

segments.en: Funding a really important IPO. And this is the same that you had with SpaceX.
segments.zh: 为一个非常重要的IPO提供资金。这和SpaceX的情况一样。

segments.en: It came off well when that happened.
segments.zh: 当时市场反应良好。

segments.en: And then, if you wanted to point to Jensen Wang news, the markets are already digested that.
segments.zh: 然后，如果你想提黄仁勋的消息，市场已经消化了。

segments.en: We're past it. We're way past it. And so what investors are trying to grapple with is, what does the demand for all things AI look like in 27 and 28 and 2030?
segments.zh: 我们已经过了那个阶段。早就过了。所以市场参与者正在努力应对的是，27年、28年和2030年对AI所有相关事物的需求会是什么样子？

segments.en: And there was no incremental news. It seemed like the market was just having indigestion on all of this.
segments.zh: 而且没有增量消息。市场似乎只是对这一切感到消化不良。

segments.en: But the earnings estimates keep getting ratchet and higher.
segments.zh: 但盈利预期却在不断上调。

segments.en: I mean, you're hearing these companies saying that their outlets are even better than they thought.
segments.zh: 我的意思是，你听到这些公司说他们的销售渠道比他们想象的还要好。

segments.en: If you look at the price amount, I look at this on the Bloomberg terminal all the time, what is the price for renting computer capacity?
segments.zh: 如果你看价格，我经常在彭博终端上看这个，租用计算能力的价格是多少？

segments.en: And it keeps going up. Demand is just keeps getting higher and higher.
segments.zh: 而且它一直在涨。需求只是越来越高。

segments.en: So I think this is all over done.
segments.zh: 所以我认为这都过头了。

segments.en: All right, so the Goldman trading does said the sell-off has spread across systematic inventories
segments.zh: 好的，所以高盛交易部门表示，抛售已经蔓延到系统性的库存中。
